> AGENT

Done. `raven-frontend` client is live in the `raven` realm:

- **Client ID:** `raven-frontend`
- **Type:** Public (SPA)
- **PKCE:** S256
- **Redirect URIs:** `https://app.ravencloak.org/*`, `https://ravencloak.org/*`, `https://www.ravencloak.org/*`
- **Web Origins:** all three (CORS)

Try `https://app.ravencloak.org` again — Keycloak should now accept the login flow. Also, once the deployment is stable, export the updated realm JSON so the client is baked into the `deploy/keycloak/raven-realm.json` file for fresh installs:

```bash
docker exec ec2-keycloak-1 /opt/keycloak/bin/kc.sh export \
  --realm raven --dir /tmp/export --users skip
docker cp ec2-keycloak-1:/tmp/export/raven-realm.json \
  /opt/raven/deploy/keycloak/raven-realm.json
```

```
1	import { defineStore } from 'pinia'
2	import { ref, computed } from 'vue'
3	import Keycloak from 'keycloak-js'
4	import { usePostHog } from '../plugins/posthog'
5	
6	export interface AuthUser {
7	  id: string
8	  email: string
9	  username: string
10	  orgId: string
11	  orgRole: string
12	}
13	
14	const keycloak = new Keycloak({
15	  url: import.meta.env.VITE_KEYCLOAK_URL ?? 'http://localhost:8080',
16	  realm: import.meta.env.VITE_KEYCLOAK_REALM ?? 'raven',
17	  clientId: import.meta.env.VITE_KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_ID ?? 'raven-admin',
18	})
19	
20	export const useAuthStore = defineStore('auth', () => {
21	  const user = ref<AuthUser | null>(null)
22	  const accessToken = ref<string | null>(null)
23	  const initialized = ref(false)
24	
25	  const isAuthenticated = computed(() => initialized.value && !!accessToken.value)
26	
27	  async function init(): Promise<void> {
28	    try {
29	      const authenticated = await keycloak.init({
30	        onLoad: 'check-sso',
31	        pkceMethod: 'S256',
32	        silentCheckSsoRedirectUri: window.location.origin + '/silent-check-sso.html',
33	      })
34	      if (authenticated) {
35	        _syncFromKeycloak()
36	        // Auto-refresh token 30s before expiry
37	        setInterval(() => keycloak.updateToken(30), 60_000)
38	      }
39	    } catch {
40	      // Keycloak unavailable — proceed as unauthenticated
41	    } finally {
42	      initialized.value = true
43	    }
44	  }
45	
46	  function login(): void {
47	    keycloak.login({ redirectUri: window.location.origin + '/dashboard' })
48	  }
49	
50	  function logout(): void {
51	    // Reset PostHog identity before logging out.
52	    const { reset: resetPostHog } = usePostHog()
53	    resetPostHog()
54	    keycloak.logout({ redirectUri: window.location.origin + '/' })
55	  }
56	
57	  function _syncFromKeycloak(): void {
58	    const p = keycloak.tokenParsed as Record<string, unknown>
59	    accessToken.value = keycloak.token ?? null
60	    user.value = {
61	      id: p['sub'] as string,
62	      email: p['email'] as string,
63	      username: p['preferred_username'] as string,
64	      orgId: p['org_id'] as string,
65	      orgRole: p['org_role'] as string,
66	    }
67	
68	    // Identify the authenticated user in PostHog for analytics.
69	    const { identify } = usePostHog()
70	    identify(user.value.id, {
71	      email: user.value.email,
72	      username: user.value.username,
```

**Infinite redirect** — `silentCheckSsoRedirectUri` points to `/silent-check-sso.html` which doesn't exist in `public/`, so nginx serves `index.html` instead. **"Raven Cloudflare" title** — that's the GitHub OAuth App name registered in your GitHub developer settings. I'll address both now.

> AGENT

Found the loop. The router's `beforeEach` guard calls `auth.login()` → full Keycloak redirect → lands back on `/dashboard#code=...` → `keycloak.init()` tries to exchange the code, but `checkLoginIframe: true` (default) creates a Keycloak session iframe that Cloudflare blocks via cookie policy → exchange fails silently → `authenticated = false` → guard fires again → repeat.

Fix: disable `checkLoginIframe` and also guard the router to not call `login()` while Keycloak is still processing the code from the URL:

> TOOL

tool_use Edit
id: toolu_01TkJLSWXsBNb47aq8MxQdyW
```json
{
  "replace_all": false,
  "file_path": "/Users/jobinlawrance/Project/raven/frontend/src/stores/auth.ts",
  "old_string": "      const authenticated = await keycloak.init({\n        onLoad: 'check-sso',\n        pkceMethod: 'S256',\n        silentCheckSsoRedirectUri: window.location.origin + '/silent-check-sso.html',\n      })",
  "new_string": "      const authenticated = await keycloak.init({\n        onLoad: 'check-sso',\n        pkceMethod: 'S256',\n        silentCheckSsoRedirectUri: window.location.origin + '/silent-check-sso.html',\n        // Must be false behind Cloudflare — the iframe-based session check uses\n        // third-party cookies that CF strips, causing an infinite redirect loop.\n        checkLoginIframe: false,\n      })"
}
```

```json
{
  "replace_all": false,
  "file_path": "/Users/jobinlawrance/Project/raven/frontend/src/router/index.ts",
  "old_string": "router.beforeEach(async (to) => {\n  if (to.meta.requiresAuth) {\n    const auth = useAuthStore()\n    if (!auth.isAuthenticated) {\n      auth.login()\n      return false\n    }\n  }\n\n  if (to.name === 'login') {\n    const auth = useAuthStore()\n    if (auth.isAuthenticated) {\n      return { name: 'dashboard' }\n    }\n  }\n})",
  "new_string": "router.beforeEach(async (to) => {\n  // If the URL contains a Keycloak callback code, let keycloak.init() finish\n  // processing it before we evaluate auth state. Without this guard the router\n  // fires before the token exchange completes and triggers another redirect.\n  if (window.location.href.includes('code=') && window.location.href.includes('state=')) {\n    return\n  }\n\n  if (to.meta.requiresAuth) {\n    const auth = useAuthStore()\n    if (!auth.isAuthenticated) {\n      auth.login()\n      return false\n    }\n  }\n\n  if (to.name === 'login') {\n    const auth = useAuthStore()\n    if (auth.isAuthenticated) {\n      return { name: 'dashboard' }\n    }\n  }\n})"
}
```

**Immediate (before calling the deployment stable):**

1. **Rebuild the frontend on the server** — PR #267 merged but the server is still running the pre-fix image. Run the rebuild command from earlier to pick up `checkLoginIframe: false`.

2. **Export Keycloak realm JSON** — the live realm now has `raven-frontend`, `beszel`, `dockhand`, `openobserve` clients that aren't in `deploy/keycloak/raven-realm.json`. Fresh installs will be missing them.
   ```bash
   docker exec ec2-keycloak-1 /opt/keycloak/bin/kc.sh export \
     --realm raven --dir /tmp/export --users skip

     /opt/raven/deploy/keycloak/raven-realm.json
   ```

3. **Create v0.3.0 release** — triggers versioned Docker builds (`ghcr.io/ravencloak-org/frontend:v0.3.0` etc.) so server deploys can pin to a version instead of `:latest`.

4. **Fix GitHub OAuth App name** — rename it at github.com → Settings → Developer settings → OAuth Apps.

> AGENT

`authenticated: true` 330 times — the auth works but the page is in a reload loop! The issue is **double login handling**: `onLoad: 'login-required'` handles auth before the app mounts, but then the router guard also calls `auth.login()`. They fight each other.

With `login-required`, by the time the app mounts, auth is always resolved. The router guard's `login()` call is redundant and creates the loop. Let me fix both files:

> TOOL

tool_use Edit
id: toolu_011dJFYLAKXEZ4a5jpAYizKa
```json
{
  "replace_all": false,
  "file_path": "/Users/jobinlawrance/Project/raven/frontend/src/router/index.ts",
  "old_string": "router.beforeEach(async (to) => {\n  if (to.meta.requiresAuth) {\n    const auth = useAuthStore()\n    if (!auth.isAuthenticated) {\n      auth.login()\n      return false\n    }\n  }\n\n  if (to.name === 'login') {\n    const auth = useAuthStore()\n    if (auth.isAuthenticated) {\n      return { name: 'dashboard' }\n    }\n  }\n})",
  "new_string": "router.beforeEach(async (to) => {\n  const auth = useAuthStore()\n\n  // With onLoad: 'login-required', Keycloak guarantees the user is\n  // authenticated before the app mounts.  The guard only needs to handle\n  // in-app navigation to protected routes after a logout, and redirect\n  // authenticated users away from the login page.\n  if (to.meta.requiresAuth && !auth.isAuthenticated) {\n    return { name: 'login' }\n  }\n\n  if (to.name === 'login' && auth.isAuthenticated) {\n    return { name: 'dashboard' }\n  }\n})"
}
```
